facts.fact: Burundi carried out its combined population, housing, agriculture and livestock census (RGPHAE) in 2024, run entirely in digital mode.

BDI.note: Definitive results only before the Council of Ministers as a draft decree on 2026-08-28; not stated as published, so no results fact.

GNQ.note: Says Equatorial Guinea is preparing its 5th census; only a study visit to Burundi, no dated concrete step, so no fact.
